translations.answer: Within MaskedMimic's 69-DoF simulated SMPL character, AMASS/HumanML3D/SAMP data, and Isaac Gym environment, a full-motion teacher is trained first and then distilled with student-distribution DAgger, temporally persistent structured masking, and a learned-prior conditional VAE. This allows one partially constrained policy to reuse keyframe, sparse-joint, text, and object interfaces. In Table 6, removing structured masking reduces the held-out seating-task success rate from 96.9% to 0%, but this evidence does not guarantee humanoid-robot hardware or safety-critical deployment.
translations.applicability.assumptions.0: A full-motion teacher can already track the target corpus in the simulated character and scene distribution.
translations.applicability.assumptions.1: User interfaces can be encoded as persistent partial pose, text, terrain, or object constraints with explicit masks and target times.
translations.applicability.assumptions.2: Deployment remains within the paper's simulated SMPL character setting; robot hardware requires an independent transfer and safety case.
translations.applicability.environments.0: AMASS evaluation on flat and procedurally irregular terrain
translations.applicability.robots.0: 69-DoF neutral-shape SMPL simulated character; no humanoid-robot hardware
translations.confidence_rationale: The paper reports full-body and VR tracking, irregular-terrain tasks, 5,000-episode goal-engineered evaluations, and a strong object-interaction ablation in which removing structured masking reduces success from 96.9% to 0%. Pinned official code exposes the sparse masking and learned-prior VAE mechanisms. Confidence is capped because the evidence is simulation-only, some comparison baselines are inherited from prior reports, and current ProtoMotions 3 does not reproduce the complete paper-era text and object configuration.
translations.evidence.0.locator: Figures 3 and 5, Equations 6-8, Tables 1-6, and Appendix A-B
translations.evidence.0.note: Defines full-teacher to partial-student distillation, structured masks, learned-prior conditional VAE, simulation scale, tracking and task metrics, and the mechanism ablation.
